kind: bounded descriptive comparison of public replicated MD ensembles (de Buhr & Gräter, Dryad 10.5061/dryad.9cnp5hqnx): Abl kinase-only model with a kinked alphaI helix, with vs without myristoyl. Descriptive real-MD evidence only; no experimental endpoint, no biological validation
frozen_before: any trajectory, archive or topology file of the dataset was downloaded or inspected (only the Dryad metadata, the rendered README and the eLife text were read)
question: At which kinase-domain windows do the Myr and noMyr ensembles differ by more than replicate runs of the same condition differ, for TopoFold kappa/tau and for equal-information Calpha baselines, and is any such window reproduced in both independent thermostat sets?
separation_from_ayaz: This myristoyl/allostery question is unrelated to the Ayaz M472I/imatinib-resistance question and its HDX endpoint; no result here is used for, or reported as evidence on, the ABL WT vs M472I preregistration
not_claimed: causality of Myr on any region

members_used: Set1/ and Set2/: system.gro, system_em.gro, topol.top, production_md.mdp, nvt.mdp, npt.mdp; per-replicate md.tpr

inputs.location: benchmarks/audit/abl_myr_1/data_dryad/ (git-ignored); archives are never edited; extracted members go to data_dryad/extracted/

budget.note: exceeding any limit stops the run before further work; the actual use is recorded

groups.primary_set: Set1 (v-rescale thermostat): Myr = traj_kinked_Myr_11..20, noMyr = traj_kinked_noMyr_11..20
groups.replication_set: Set2 (Nosé–Hoover thermostat): Myr = traj_kinked_Myr_21..30, noMyr = traj_kinked_noMyr_21..30
groups.replicate_unit: a whole run; frames are never treated as independent; the two sets are analysed separately and never pooled

gates.G0_access_and_hashes: the three archives are present and their SHA-256 equal the Dryad digests above; otherwise STOP (blocked: access)
gates.G1_members: every member in members_used exists; a missing member stops the run (no substitute)
gates.G2_topology: each XTC is read with the existing MDAnalysis adapter using KD_noIa_bb_ref.pdb as topology (average.pdb if and only if KD_noIa_bb_ref.pdb has a different atom count from the XTC and average.pdb matches; the choice is recorded); all 40 XTC have the same atom count; atom names are backbone; the phi/psi comparator runs only if N, CA and C are present for every residue
gates.G3_mapping: topofold_inputs.kinase_roles maps the topology chain to P00519-2 with Numbering('reference', 0) and anchors beta3_Lys 290, alphaC_Glu 305, HRD_H 380, DFG_Asp 400 (isoform 1b); refusal stops the run; mutations, unobserved ranges and the author-numbering offset are reported
gates.G4_shared_start: within each set, the protein atoms of system.gro are identical between Myr and noMyr (max |Δx| <= 0.001 nm over all protein atoms); production_md.mdp files are identical between Myr and noMyr after removing comments and whitespace; topol.top differ only by the Myr molecule and its parameters; replicate initialisation (gen_vel / gen_seed, continuation) is recorded from the mdp files; any other difference stops the run
gates.G5_frames: per run: time stamps from the XTC; the analysis window is t >= 1000 ns (as in the paper); if the file starts at or after 1000 ns all frames are used; frame interval 2 ns within 0.01 ns; a run with fewer than 450 analysis frames is excluded with its cause; if a group of a set keeps fewer than 8 runs, that set is not analysed
gates.G6_breaks_and_exclusions: Calpha–Calpha break and missing-coordinate records from the adapter define excluded windows (existing exclusion machinery); if more than 5 % of windows of any channel are excluded, STOP

method.tool: topofold_inputs.ensemble analyze() on members read by the existing adapter; options bins = 36, max_lag = 50 frames (100 ns), pbc = 'none' unless G6 shows breaks caused by periodic wrapping, in which case pbc = 'make_whole' is used and recorded

equal_information_baselines: rmsf: per-residue Calpha RMSF of each run after superposition of each frame on the run's first analysis frame over all Calpha atoms (topofold_inputs.qcp_rmsd); compared per residue as |RMSF_a - RMSF_b| over run pairs
stronger_information_comparator: phi, psi per residue (backbone N, CA, C; kinase_geometry.dihedral; circular histograms, 36 bins); reported separately, never as an equal-information baseline

method.per_window_statistic: E = median over cross-condition run pairs of the run-pair distance minus max(median over within-Myr pairs, median over within-noMyr pairs); run-pair distance is the Jensen–Shannon distance of run histograms (ensemble.py between_member_js_median and within_member_js_median_*) or, for rmsf, |RMSF difference|
method.replicate_exceeding: E > 0 in the full set AND in all 20 leave-one-run-out recomputations (one run removed from either group)
method.reproduced: replicate_exceeding in both Set1 and Set2
method.residue_sets: R_c = union of residue spans of reproduced windows of channel c (kappa and d_i_i2: i-1..i+1; tau and d_i_i3: i-1..i+2; rmsf, phi, psi: i); R_T = R_kappa ∪ R_tau; R_B = R_d_i_i2 ∪ R_d_i_i3 ∪ R_rmsf; N2(X) = X expanded by ±2 residues
method.temporal_dependence: per run and window the existing temporal diagnostics (autocorrelation to lag 50 frames) are reported; no effective-sample-size correction is used because no inferential statistic is computed (D33)
method.no_inference: no p-values, confidence intervals or significance labels (D33); the authors' p-values are not used

outcomes_ordered.label: blocked
outcomes_ordered.rule: any gate G0–G6 fails; the exact gate and remedy are reported and nothing is computed

outcomes_ordered.label: inconclusive
outcomes_ordered.rule: no channel (TopoFold, baselines or comparator) has a reproduced window

outcomes_ordered.label: partial
outcomes_ordered.rule: every remaining case (1–2 TopoFold residues outside N2(R_B))

also_reported: counts of replicate-exceeding windows per channel and set
Jaccard of reproduced windows between channels
permitted_interpretation: Descriptive real-MD evidence about where these two simulated ensembles differ beyond replicate variability, and whether TopoFold localizes residues the equal-information baselines do not. Not biological validation; not evidence about M472I, imatinib or HDX.
code_freeze: the runner script is written after this spec freeze and its SHA-256 is recorded in results/ABL-MYR-1_code_freeze.json before any input archive is opened; any later change to spec or runner is a dated amendment in a separate directory
